title: OIS Ingestion Job Configuration Schema
description: Standard schema for declaring, scaling, and managing ingestion crawl jobs across vendors.

name.description: Unique identify name of the crawl job.

owner.description: Owner group or email responsible for the job.

schedule.description: Standard crontab schedule pattern indicating when to trigger the crawl job.

type.description: Identifier of the source connector class (e.g. sharepoint-source, s3-source, cmis-source, bpmn2-source).

config.description: Connection endpoints, credentials reference, and connector-specific scan options.

transformation.description: Configuration for document and metadata transformation (e.g., auto-narrativization) prior to chunking.

strategy.description: The technique used to transform metadata fields and variables into a semantic, human-readable text payload.

template.description: Mustache or standard text template mapping schema/metadata variables into a text payload.

model.description: Identifier of the AI embedding model name (e.g. mxbai-embed-large, nomic-embed-text, all-minilm).

provider.description: Embedding provider name (e.g. ollama, openai, huggingface).

endpoint.description: Service endpoint URL for the embedding provider.

type.description: Identifier of the destination index writer connector class (e.g. pgvector, elasticsearch).

config.description: Database targets, table schemas, dimension values, and vector indexing algorithms.
